messages.subject: UT Austin Student Interested in Banking @ Citi (Referred by Miranda)
messages.body:
Hello Nicholas,

I hope you are doing well. I am emailing after coincidently learning from your sister (gf of my roommate) that you are an analyst at Citi. I am an undergraduate Economics & Business student at the University of Texas, and I'm pursuing a career in Investment Banking. I'd love to talk to you to learn more about your experience at Citi given I'm particularly interested in Banking in New York.

If you have any free time in the next week, it would be great to set up a quick phone call with you. I am pretty open and can likely adjust my schedule to accommodate whatever works best for you. Please let me know if you would be willing to do this. Attached is my resume.

Best,
Jonathan

Hi Jonathan,

Nice to hear from you and hope you’re doing well too!

I’d love to chat and give you a bit of background on my experience in the industry and during the recruiting process. Thursday or Friday morning would work best on my end. Are you available at 10 am cst (11 am est) on Thursday?

Look forward to chatting.

Best,
Nick Gerstein

messages.body:
Nick – I appreciate the response. Thursday (1/25) at 10 am cst is perfect. I'll send you a calendar invite, and I look forward to talking with you then.

Best,
Jonathan

messages.subject: Re: UT Austin Student Interested in Banking @ Citi (Referred by Miranda)
messages.body:
Hey Nick,

I really appreciate you spending the time to hop on the phone with me today. Your candid advice and general insight to my recruitment process were very useful, and I'm super appreciative of that. You provided me with some solid guidance as I continue my recruitment process. I wish you best of luck in your future endeavors as your transition beyond IB upon receiving your promotion. Thanks again!

Best,
Jonathan
